Location: 17 Beach Street, Harrington NSW 2427 
Salary: $80,000 plus 12% superannuation
Position; Full time, Permanent

Nishtha Enterprise Pty Ltd as Trustee for the Nishtha Enterprise Family Trust operates Bottlemart Harrington, a well-established independent liquor retail store located in Harrington, New South Wales. The business offers an extensive range of beers, wines, spirits, premixed drinks and other beverage products, supported by a strong commitment to responsible service, competitive pricing and quality customer service. 

An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced and motivated Retail Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of the store. This role is responsible for ensuring efficient store management, leading and developing staff, maintaining optimum inventory levels, delivering exceptional customer service, and driving sales performance while ensuring compliance with all relevant liquor licensing and workplace health and safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

-	Manage the daily operations of the retail store to ensure efficient, profitable and customer-focused performance. 
-	Lead, recruit, train, supervise and motivate store employees to achieve high standards of customer service and operational efficiency. 
-	Monitor customer service standards and promptly resolve customer enquiries and complaints. 
-	Determine product range, maintain appropriate inventory levels and coordinate purchasing to ensure product availability. 
-	Develop and implement merchandising, promotional and pricing strategies to maximise sales and profitability. 
-	Monitor stock movements, minimise stock losses and conduct regular stocktakes. 
-	Oversee cash handling, banking, financial transactions and end-of-day reconciliation procedures. 
-	Prepare operational reports, monitor store performance and implement strategies to achieve sales and profitability targets. 
-	Ensure compliance with liquor licensing legislation, Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) requirements, workplace health and safety regulations, and company policies. 
-	Coordinate with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of products and maintain effective supplier relationships. 
-	Maintain a clean, organised and safe retail environment that promotes an excellent customer experience. 
-	Monitor store presentation, displays and merchandising standards to maximise product visibility and sales opportunities. 

Minimum Requirements

-	AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in Business, Retail Management, Management or a related field. 
-	Minimum one year of full-time experience in a similar Retail Manager position within the retail industry. 
-	In the absence of formal qualifications, at least three years of relevant full-time experience may substitute for the qualification. 
-	Demonstrated experience managing retail operations, supervising staff and achieving sales and operational targets. 

Skills & Attributes

-	Strong leadership, staff supervision and team development skills. 
-	Sound knowledge of retail operations, inventory management and merchandising principles. 
-	Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. 
-	Ability to analyse sales performance and implement strategies to improve business outcomes. 
-	Strong understanding of workplace health and safety requirements and liquor licensing obligations. 
-	Proficiency in retail point-of-sale and inventory management systems. 

If you are a passionate and experienced retail professional looking for a leadership role, we would  love to hear from you!
To apply for this position, email your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au  

Please note only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

About Us

Advanced Group Australia is a leading provider of skilled labour solutions across construction, civil, and industrial sectors. With a strong presence in New South Wales and an ongoing commitment to safety, quality, and workforce development, we work with top-tier clients on major infrastructure and building projects. Our team takes pride in delivering reliable, qualified personnel who keep projects moving and completed to the highest standards.

We are currently seeking an experienced and reliable Sheet Metal Worker to join our growing team.

Role

As a Sheet Metal Worker, you will be responsible for fabricating, assembling, installing, and repairing sheet metal products and structures. This includes working with materials such as stainless steel, aluminium, and galvanised iron for applications in construction, HVAC, and industrial installations. You will collaborate with supervisors, tradespeople, and site managers to deliver precise and safe workmanship that aligns with project specifications.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
- Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and specifications for fabrication and installation.
- Measure, cut, bend, and shape sheet metal using hand tools, machines, and cutting equipment.
- Assemble and join sheet metal components using welding, riveting, and fastening techniques.
- Install sheet metal products, such as ductwork, roofing, flashing, panels, and frameworks on construction sites.
- Perform modifications or repairs on existing installations, ensuring all work meets quality and safety standards.
- Operate and maintain workshop machinery and tools with care and attention to safety protocols.
- Conduct inspections and quality checks on finished products or installations.
- Comply with all site safety requirements and Advanced Group’s work health and safety (WHS) procedures.

Skills & Qualifications
- AQF Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (Sheet Metal Working) or similar (ANZSCO Skill Level 3).
- Minimum 3 years’ experience in sheet metal fabrication, installation, or maintenance.
- Proficiency in working with a range of sheet metal tools and machinery.
- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
- Good communication skills and ability to work as part of a team.
- White Card (Construction Induction).
- Valid driver’s licence and reliable transport.

Australian citizens and permanent residents encouraged to apply.

Salary & Location
Salary: $78,000 – $80,000 per annum plus superannuation (commensurate with experience).
Location: Advanced Group Australia, Guildford NSW 2161.

Employer: Industrial Automation Group
Location: Joondalup, WA
Salary: $75,000 – $95,000 per annum plus superannuation
Employment Type: Full-Time

Industrial Automation Group is an innovative engineering and technology solutions provider specialising in automation, control systems, and Industrial IoT solutions. The company designs, develops, and delivers integrated engineering solutions to improve operational efficiency, asset performance, and system reliability across various industries.

With expertise in automation technologies, intelligent control systems, remote monitoring solutions, and engineering project delivery, IA Group provides customised solutions to meet complex operational requirements.

IA Group is seeking an experienced Automation and Control Engineer to join its engineering team on a full-time basis. The successful candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing the design, implementation, modification, and ongoing performance of automation and control systems, equipment, and industrial plant solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Reviewing project requirements, functional specifications, operational processes, and technical information to determine system functions, engineering requirements, and improvement opportunities.
Analysing operational data, equipment performance, facility layouts, and production requirements to identify opportunities for improving system efficiency, reliability, and productivity.
Designing, developing, and implementing electrical, automation, and control systems for industrial automation projects, including configuring PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems to enable process monitoring, control, data acquisition, and reporting.
Developing and modifying PLC control programs using industry-standard programming methodologies, including function block diagrams, ladder logic, and IEC 61131-3 programming standards to optimise automated processes and equipment performance.
Preparing engineering specifications, technical documentation, system designs, and project reports, including determining suitable equipment, control components, system configurations, and installation requirements.
Performing system integration, testing, commissioning, and validation activities, including Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), to ensure automation systems meet design specifications and operational requirements.

Skills and Experience Required

To be successful in this role, you will have:

A Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Control Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 2–3 years of demonstrated experience in industrial automation, control systems, and engineering project delivery.
Experience with PLC programming, HMI configuration, SCADA systems, and industrial control technologies.
Knowledge of automation system integration, commissioning, testing, and maintenance processes.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and system documentation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and resolve complex technical issues.

What We Offer
Full-time permanent employment opportunity.
Competitive salary package of $75,000 – $95,000 plus superannuation.
Opportunity to work on innovative industrial automation and engineering projects.
Supportive and professional engineering environment with opportunities for career development.

Apply Now:
If you are an experienced Automation and Control Engineer looking to contribute to innovative engineering solutions, please submit your application with your resume and relevant experience.

Full-Time: Immediate start
Job Title: Retail Manager
Salary range: $79,500 - $85,000
Job Closure date: 30 days

ABOUT THE ROLE
Our client is an acclaimed artisan bakery built on craftsmanship, community, and conscious hospitality. With a loyal following and reputation for exceptional product and genuine connection, they are seeking a hands-on Retail Manager to lead one of their high-profile market venues.
This is a leadership role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, sensory environment—where a market stall carries the same warmth and intention as a fine dining room. You’ll have genuine autonomy to shape the customer experience, develop your team, and drive profitability. If you lead with empathy and pride in operational excellence, this is for you.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operations & Financial Control
· Manage venue operations including rostering, purchasing, and cost of goods, ensuring budget and sustainability targets are met.
· Flex labour hours dynamically in response to real-time business and weather conditions.
· Oversee stock control, invoice accuracy, and wastage reduction through proactive management.
· Conduct quality checks and resolve defects before product reaches customers.
· Identify operational improvements and collaborate with production and quality assurance teams.

Team Leadership & Development
· Lead, coach, and inspire a team of up to 20+, fostering warmth, accountability, and shared purpose.
· Manage the full performance cycle—onboarding, feedback, training, and career progression.
· Handle performance matters confidently and compassionately, in line with Fair Work standards.
· Participate in recruitment, ensuring new hires align with the brand’s values and service ethos.
· Champion change and ensure the team is equipped and motivated to adapt.

Customer Experience & Brand Leadership
· Embody genuine, unhurried hospitality; ensure every guest interaction reflects warmth and appreciation.
· Resolve customer complaints with discretion and follow-through.
· Brief the team daily on service standards, product knowledge, and experience expectations.
· Act as the ‘voice’ of the brand within the venue, ensuring consistency in tone, behaviour, and presentation.

Safety, Hygiene & Food Quality
· Maintain a zero-harm environment by enforcing safe work practices and conducting hazard reviews.
· Ensure full compliance with HACCP, GMP, and personal hygiene standards across all food handling and dispatch.
· Conduct routine product protection checks and support the broader Quality Agenda.

Administration & Compliance
· Maintain accurate filing and communication systems for senior leadership, HR, and product teams.
· Track colleagues leave balances to ensure coverage without compromising service or budget.
· Follow up on non-compliance issues promptly and escalate where required.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
· Proven min 1 year experience in retail, hospitality, or venue management.
· Strong financial acumen—rostering, COGS, and budget control.
· Demonstrated ability to lead and develop diverse teams in high-volume environments.
· Excellent communication skills; comfortable giving feedback, managing conflict, and facilitating change.
· Flexibility to work early mornings, weekends, and public holidays across multiple market locations.
· Physically capable standing for long periods, lifting up to 15kg, working in varying weather conditions.

WHY JOIN?
· Respected, independent Australian brand known for quality and heart.
· Genuine career development and mentorship opportunities.
· Work with exceptional product in a setting that values tradition and innovation.
· Competitive salary + benefits.

TO APPLY
Submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your leadership philosophy and interest in the artisan food space.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. This role is advertised exclusively on behalf of our client

Title: OutSystems Developer / Consultant
Company: KRE8 IT Pty Ltd
Location: Narre Warren / Melbourne based preferred, with the option to work remotely within Australia. Applicants must be based in Australia due to the regulatory requirements of some of our clients.
Salary: $110,000 - $140,000 per annum, depending on relevant experience
Employment type: Full-time

About KRE8 IT
KRE8 IT is a Melbourne-based technology consulting company specialising in practical software delivery, low-code development, systems integration, and digital transformation. We work with clients to design, build, and support business-critical applications, with a strong focus on governed delivery, maintainable architecture, and high-quality outcomes.
We are seeking an OutSystems Developer / Consultant to support the design, development, implementation, and ongoing improvement of OutSystems applications for our clients.

About the role
The OutSystems Developer / Consultant will work across the full delivery lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, application development, integration, testing, deployment support, and continuous improvement. The role requires strong hands-on OutSystems development capability as well as the ability to work in a consulting environment with clients and internal delivery teams.

Key responsibilities
*   Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using OutSystems.
*   Work with both OutSystems O11 and OutSystems Developer Cloud environments.
*   Translate business requirements into reliable, maintainable application solutions.
*   Develop integrations with external systems, APIs, data services, and business platforms.
*   Support implementation of complex business workflows, decision logic, and rules-driven functionality.
*   Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, designers, analysts, and other developers to deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
*   Contribute to application architecture, technical design, estimation, documentation, and delivery planning.
*   Troubleshoot, optimise, and improve existing OutSystems applications.
*   Support quality assurance, deployment activities, and production support where required.
*   Apply secure, scalable, and maintainable development practices.

Required experience, qualifications, and skills
*   Minimum 1 year of experience developing applications with OutSystems, including both O11 and ODC.
*   A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field is required. Where the qualification is not directly relevant to the position, the applicant must demonstrate a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience.
*   Must be based in Australia and able to work with clients operating under Australian regulatory requirements.
*   Strong software development experience, including application design, data modelling, integration, testing, and debugging.
*   Experience working in consulting, client delivery, or project-based software delivery environments.
*   Ability to analyse business requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
*   Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
*   Ability to work independently and manage delivery responsibilities with attention to quality and detail.

Highly regarded
*   Demonstrated experience implementing complex decision logic using business rules management systems.
*   Experience implementing applications in the healthcare industry.
*   Working understanding of the FHIR interoperability standard.
*   Experience with API integration, workflow automation, data exchange, and enterprise application integration.
*   Relevant OutSystems certifications.

How to apply
Please apply through this job advertisement platform with your resume and a short cover note outlining your relevant OutSystems experience, including your experience with O11 and ODC.

•	Develop and maintain Advanced reporting system.
•	Emphasis on understanding dashboards and applying MMM findings, statistical testing to media planning.
•	Support agency new business process, as directed.
•	Assist in, inspiring and motivating the team to work collectively on the client's vision and objectives.
•	Work on new business projects as required.
•	Proactively seek new business opportunities.
•	Manage and mentor junior team members.
•	Efficiently collaborate with account leaders and their planning team members for planning & deployment of the optimization strategies adopted for driving paid media efficiencies on an ongoing basis. 
•	Drive platform expertise in Google GMP and Adobe Experience stack & Ad Cloud. Additional great to have hands on experience in CRM platforms such as Salesforce & Google ADH deployment. 
•	Experience managing Analytics / MarTech relationships and cross functional stakeholder management

Analytics Director (aka: Analytics & Insights Director, Analytics & Insights Lead)
The Analytics Directors role is to understand the client’s business and chart a roadmap for the role of Data & analytics in the clients business. They will provide guidance on the key strategic use cases for Google / Adobe analytics platform, advise on data modelling methods to be used for client business intelligence needs and drive the governance on client Data management processes, platforms & methods. 
Guide the strategic insights output for clients and build the role and importance of digital analytics & Business Intelligence both in client business and to drive media & communications objectives. 
leverage analytics data for bringing efficiencies in media deliveries and highlighting opportunities for clients to leverage in their everyday business decision making.

•	Oversee and work alongside internal teams on new & existing client projects, campaigns and how analytics as a function can support on the same. 
•	Formally document the analytics platform tests & strategies adopted and present findings and recommendations to cross functional teams across internal and external stakeholders. 
•	Own people management & development of team members including their goal setting, ensuring their high levels of service and the day to day people management duties such as administration including timesheets and approving leave. 
•	Advanced (10+ years) & hands-on working knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Marketing Platform, Data visualisation platforms like Looker, Tableau and data processing skills -SQL, Big Query . 
•	Advanced experience of GMP product suite, Adobe (good to have), leveraged research platforms/ tools in business and audience insights generation and planning.

About the role
Join the Australian Safety Wholesalers' team as an Account Manager NSW/ACT/VIC. In this full-time role based in Greater Sydney, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with customers across NSW and ACT. The territory of Victoria is currently shared between the various account managers. You will play a crucial part in driving the company's sales growth and ensuring exceptional customer service.

What you'll be doing
* Proactively manage and grow a portfolio of existing accounts across NSW/ACT and parts of Victoria
* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients through regular communication and engagement
* Identify new business opportunities to secure new accounts
* Provide expert product knowledge and offer tailored solutions to meet client needs
* Collaborate with the your peers and owners of the business to develop targeted campaigns and new product developments
* Maintain detailed records of all client interactions and sales activities
* Work closely with the operations team to ensure efficient order processing
* Actively contribute to the company's sales strategy and participate in team meetings

What we're looking for
* Minimum 1 years' experience in a sales or account management role, preferably within the safety or wholesale industry
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build lasting relationships with clients
* Excellent negotiation and problem-solving skills to handle client requests and complaints effectively
* Demonstrated track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets
* Proficient in using Microsoft word, excel and outlook email systems
* Knowledge of workplace health and safety regulations and compliance requirements

What we offer
At Australian Safety Wholesalers', we are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. You will have the opportunity to grow your career and territory. We offer a competitive salary, motor vehicle allowance, opportunity to travel and see the region, performance-based bonuses whilst based in your home office.

About us
Australian Safety Wholesalers' is a leading provider of high-quality safety products and solutions. With over 20 years of industry experience, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional customer service and innovative products that help keep workplaces safe. Our values of integrity, innovation, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do.
